snippet.title: Rurouni Kenshin: Meiji Kenkaku Romantan: Saisen — [ PSP ] — Intro & Gameplay
snippet.description:
We journey now to a romanticized Meiji era, this is,

Rurouni Kenshin: Meiji Kenkaku Romantan: Saisen

The first print of the game included an artbook, 15 PSP themes and an arkanoid game containing an alarm clock. The game was released to celebrate the 15-year anniversary of the anime series. But I think it was struck with a rather negative reception because... This game is just boring.

At launch, this game was plagued by slowdown and other issues. There are some people who love this game, but there's also people who love Evangelion so, you know, whatever.

I don't recommend this game.

Please leave a Like / Dislike and Comment!
